row.evidence: Checkmarx One's identity-provider docs cover only SAML (Okta, Azure AD), OpenID Connect and LDAP; with SAML 'Checkmarx automatically imports the user' on SSO login, and no SCIM endpoint appears anywhere in the docs or API reference.
row.notes: Quote-only pricing ('priced per package', Essentials / Professional / Enterprise, each 'Get A Custom Quote'). None by absence with JIT: users are created manually in Identity and Access Management, imported just-in-time on SAML login (attribute, role and group mappers), or synced from LDAP; the full Checkmarx One docs navigation (1,600+ entries) and the Stoplight API reference have no SCIM page. Recorded as JIT-only (none); reclassify at merge if JIT-only is treated differently. SSO plan is not stated on the pricing page. A non-SCIM Access Management REST API lists users, groups, clients and roles and manages role assignments; user creation is not in that API. Row named after the product sold today (Checkmarx One); legacy self-hosted CxSAST Access Control also has SAML/LDAP and a REST API.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Also sold 'By Security Area' (Start with SAST, Start with Supply Chain), also quote-only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented. Identity providers supported: SAML 2.0 (Okta, Azure AD guides), OpenID Connect and LDAP.

auth.notes: JWT access tokens generated through the Authentication API from API keys or OAuth clients.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieve users in the tenant account
Retrieve users from internal Access Management storage
Retrieve user groups in the tenant account
Update base roles for a user, group or client
Create an assignment (entity to tenant/application/project with roles)

audit_log_api.notes: GET {Base_URL}/api/audit-events includes IAM (user management) events; replaces the deprecated /api/audit.

user_api.notes: Access Management Service Phase 2 is rolling out gradually. Users, groups and roles are created in the IAM console; the documented API reads users and groups and manages roles and assignments.

okta.notes: Checkmarx's guide creates a custom SAML 2.0 app in Okta (no OIN app found at okta.com/integrations/checkmarx/ or /checkmarx-one/, both 404).

entra.notes: Checkmarx documents a SAML provider with Azure AD; no Microsoft Learn gallery tutorial found (checkmarx-tutorial 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP integration (Configuring LDAP Integration in the IAM console)
fallbacks.notes: OpenID Connect is also supported as an identity provider; JIT behaviour is documented for the Okta SAML guide.
